concept: Route 53 failover routing: active/passive with health checks
tests: Configuring automatic DNS failover to a standby Region (choose two).
expected: Failover routing policy with PRIMARY/SECONDARY + a Route 53 health check on the primary. Triggers: "normally primary", "standby only if primary is unhealthy", "automatic DNS failover".
why_not: CloudFront origin failover works at the origin level via an origin group, not DNS and not cache behaviors; S3 lifecycle has nothing to do with DNS.
